entities.summary: Arthur Lloyd Thomas was a performers & entertainers in Chicago (1851-08-22, Chicago – 1924-09-15) who made significant contributions during the Modern era. Their work intersected with economic development and trade and geopolitical linkage and diplomacy. Influenced economic patterns and commercial practices.
